site_description: What Foundry VTT packages declare, for tools that work out what to install.
home_lede: What Foundry VTT, its game systems and its modules declare in their manifests, gathered from Foundry VTT's package listing, GitHub and GitLab, for tools that work out which versions can be installed together.
endpoint_lookup_summary: A set of packages, everything they need, and how fresh each is.
endpoint_listing_summary: Every package Foundry VTT's listing offers.
endpoint_recheck_summary: Packages' own manifests, checked again now.
machine_translation_notice: This page was translated by machine and the translation has not been reviewed. If something is unclear, the English version is authoritative.
error_other: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again later.
sign_in_lede: Sign in to the Mondarth catalogue with an account you already have.
sign_in_stores: Signing in stores your name, email address and picture from the provider you choose, and the address and browser you sign in from.
sign_in_none: Signing in is not available at the moment.
sign_in_failed: Signing in did not work. Please try again.
profile_handle_hint: Given to you at random when your profile was made. It is shown wherever you have set no nickname.
nickname_hint: 3 to 32 letters, digits, spaces, hyphens or underscores, shown in place of your user id. Leave it empty to be shown by your user id.
nickname_problem_length: A nickname is 3 to 32 characters long.
nickname_problem_characters: A nickname has only letters, digits, spaces, hyphens and underscores.
nickname_problem_reserved: That nickname is kept for the site's own use.
delete_explanation: This removes your profile, the providers you sign in with and every session, all at once. It cannot be undone.
delete_confirm: I understand that this cannot be undone
delete_unconfirmed: Tick the box to confirm that you want your profile deleted.
delete_stale: For your safety, sign out and sign in again before deleting your profile: you signed in more than a day ago.
privacy_lede: Signing in to the catalogue stores what this page lists, and nothing else about you. We do not sell it, share it, or use it for advertising.
privacy_from_provider: The provider you sign in with
privacy_name_why: Shown on your profile page, to you alone.
privacy_email_what: Your email address, and whether the provider checked it
privacy_email_why: One profile for each email address. In future, to write to you about a subscription, if you take one.
privacy_picture_why: Shown on your profile page. Only its address is stored, not the picture.
privacy_handle_what: Your user id, such as amber-falcon-ridge-42
privacy_handle_why: Your name on the site until you set a nickname.
privacy_nickname_what: Your nickname, if you set one
privacy_account_what: Which provider you sign in with, and its id for your account
privacy_account_why: Recognising you when you sign in again.
privacy_tokens_what: The provider's tokens for your account, and when they expire
privacy_tokens_why: Kept, encrypted, as the provider gave them when you signed in. The catalogue does not use them to read anything more from your account.
privacy_session_what: Your sessions, and when each ends
privacy_session_why: Keeping you signed in: for 30 days, renewed while you use the site, or until you sign out.
privacy_device_what: The address and browser each session was signed in from
privacy_device_why: Seeing where your account is signed in, to help spot misuse. The address is also used, but not kept, to limit how often anyone can try to sign in.
privacy_pending_why: Checking that a provider's answer is to a sign-in started here. It is kept until the sign-in finishes; one never finished expires after 10 minutes.
privacy_times_what: When each of these was made and last changed
privacy_kept: Until you delete your profile, from your profile page, which removes all of it at once. A session ends when it expires or you sign out.
privacy_cookies: One cookie keeps you signed in, and short-lived ones hold a sign-in while it is in progress. Another keeps the language you chose.
